name: book-river
description: Book River - MERN bookstore platform (Frontend + Admin + Backend)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --workspace Backend" "npm run dev --workspace Frontend" "npm run dev --workspace Admin"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace Frontend && npm run build --workspace Admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace Frontend && npm run lint --workspace Admin
